title: Optional OCR
description: Add explicitly enabled worker-side OCR for scanned and mixed PDFs, preserving originals and physical-page provenance. Bound runtime/resources, report uncertain text and keep the normal text-PDF pipeline working.
acceptance_criteria: Scanned documents handled with explicitly enabled OCR and provenance.
test_cases: Scanned documents handled with explicitly enabled OCR and provenance.
verification: Reopened planning. Image-only PDFs currently report OCR_REQUIRED; OCR is not implemented.
